atoms.text: Joe loves to play football at lunchtime with his friends. Yesterday, they unfortunately accidentally kicked the ball through one of the school windows, and the teacher confiscated it. Today, Joe and his friends were sad because they couldn’t play football but, by the end of the lunch break, they had joined in with the group playing rugby and still had lots of fun.

atoms.text: Steven went to an art museum yesterday with his mum. He really didn’t want to go because he finds museums boring. When they were inside the museum, his mum made him look at every single painting (even though he thought he could do better paintings himself). On the way home, Steven got an ice cream as a treat, and that cheered him up.
